Saç ekimi sürecini, operasyon gününü ve: Hear our patients, together with Doğukan Denli, describe the process, the day of the operation and what came after.
Yalnızca lokal anestezi iğneleri sırasın: You only feel a few minutes of stinging during the local anaesthetic injections. After that you can watch a film, chat and have lunch during the procedure.
Ekilen saçlar tekrar döker mi?: Will the transplanted hair fall out again?
Greftler ense ve yanlardan alınır. Bu bö: Grafts are taken from the back and sides of the head. Follicles there are resistant to the hormone that causes hair loss and keep this resistance in their new place. Your existing, non-transplanted hair may continue to thin, so we give you a medication and PRP plan.
Kimler saç ekimi için uygun değil?: Who is not suitable for a hair transplant?
Donör bölgesi zayıf olanlar, kontrolsüz: People with a weak donor area, uncontrolled diabetes or heart disease, and very young patients whose hair loss has not yet stabilised. If the photo analysis shows you are not suitable, we will tell you openly.
Ne zaman işe dönebilirim?: When can I go back to work?
Masa başı işlerde 3. gün dönebilirsiniz;: With a desk job you can return on day 3; wearing a hat is not recommended until day 10. Wait a month before heavy exercise and swimming.
Kadınlara saç ekimi yapıyor musunuz?: Do you perform hair transplants for women?
Evet. Kadın hastalarda çoğunlukla tıraşs: Yes. For women we usually use unshaven DHI to lower the hairline or densify the parting.
